verdict.rationale: Pendo's Leo lets users ask questions in natural language and take action, such as building guides and segments, inside the same conversation. Pendo also exposes product intelligence through Slack, Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor, backed by an official MCP server listed in Claude's Connectors Directory. Missing for 10: documentation of which operations beyond guides and segments can be driven by natural language, in-depth first-party docs beyond marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
